from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A company's liability figure from one filing, as reported."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label (e.g., 'Total Current Liabilities', 'Total liabilities')")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount as reported in the filing")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
